headline: Callahan's Passage Erupts Anew as Warden Strongholds Slip to 154
war_summary: Since our last edition the quiet on Callahan's Passage has broken: the day's account there runs to some 6,700 Colonial and 5,750 Warden casualties, its newest flag change timed scant forty-five minutes before press, and one stronghold now lies unclaimed between the lines. The overall ledger shows 280 works under Colonial colors to 154 under Warden, with two bases reduced to no-man's-land — the Warden count four lower than at our previous filing. Weathered Expanse remains the chief storm-center with forty-six actions in the day, Wightwalk and Frostmarch busiest, and a further Warden holding there knocked to neutral ground, leaving that front five Wardens to three Colonials, one ruin between them. The Linn of Mercy, lately slackening, has roared back, hourly losses climbing steeply about The Long Whine and The First Coin. The Dead Lands bleed on, Warden losses the heavier near The Salt March, while Stlican Shelf, Godcrofts and Marban Hollow all saw ground change hands, and the casualty rolls at Viper Pit leapt suddenly in the closing hours. It is day 203; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
